usta-1700104.name: Saffron Trileçe
usta-1700104.description: A gourmet saffron blend, crafted by Hafız Mustafa 1864.
usta-1700104.ingredients: Trileçe cake ( wheat flour, eggs, sugar, orange peel, saffron, baking powder), milk syrup(milk, milk cream, whipped topping), saffron, whipped topping, Ala sauce (wheat flour, sugar, corn starch, milk cream, whipped topping).
usta-1700104.allergenInfo: Contains Gluten, dairy products, eggs, soya.
usta-1700104.servingSuggestion: Refrigerate between +4° and +6°. Keep out of direct sunlight and do not leave at room temperature for extended periods.
usta-1700104.storage: To fully enjoy the flavour and texture, allow the product to rest at room temperature for 10–15 minutes before serving.
usta-1700104.longTermStorage:
Storage: Store in the freezer at -18°.

Preparation: Thaw in a refrigerator at +4° for 8–12 hours before serving.

Caution: Do not refreeze once thawed. 
Once thawed, keep refrigerated and consume within 2 days.
